answer: Anchor each agent's reputation to a single identity whose score runs from nadir to zenith: newcomers start at the nadir with tiny trade limits, and only a long record of honest, verified work climbs the trellis toward the zenith, where large trades unlock. A Sybil attacker must therefore age and fund every fake identity separately for weeks before it can move real value, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand slow, expensive climbs — and one caught fake collapses the whole linked ladder.
